verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to supply your own LLM provider, API key, or model selection for Codegen agents. The references to wrapping a local Claude Code instance (CLI telemetry and MCP injection) describe a separate tool integration, not a documented bring-your-own-model or bring-your-own-key capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
